$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the Labs settings (cx-d5b5d); gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants. Row fields: see schemas/settings/source/updates.json.

lists.name: labs
lists.note: Settings > Advanced > Labs: surfaces still being shaped, off by default.

rows.note: Surfaces still being shaped (the agent pane's session coverage label and its Pull requests view). Off by default, so a default app shows only finished surfaces. The App Store has its own switch, labs.appStore.

help.text: Unfinished surfaces, such as the agent session's coverage label and Pull requests view.

rows.note: The App Store: its sidebar item, its actions in the palette, menus and context menus, and its page. Off by default until it is ready (David Beyer, Nov 20: "don't show the app store until it's ready"; Lawrence, Nov 23: "get rid of app store from default for now"). Its own switch, apart from Show Preview Features, so turning previews on for the music player, Click by Hint or Stats does not bring it back.

help.text: Browse, install and update apps for cmux. Still being shaped.

rows.note: Read-only live-tree compiler snapshot in the agent pane. Off by default; only opening or refreshing the popover reads status. Turning it off unmounts the experiment.

help.text: Show live-tree compiler status in the agent pane.

rows.note: Unofficial Labs feature (plans/cmux-next/voice-room-DESIGN.md): Open Voice Room transcribes the mic on device, reads the screen's text on device when it changes, and posts both to the room server at labs.voiceRoomURL, whose cheap model keeps the room's memory and sends asks spoken to Chief as tasks. Off by default; while off the Voice Room actions are unavailable everywhere. The person turns it on: agents may not (not in SettingsSchema agent-writable keys).

help.text: While a room is open, cmux sends a transcript of your mic and your screen's text to it.

rows.note: The Voice Room server (experiments/voice-room). Empty is the local server, http://127.0.0.1:4788/. A tailnet room is the https://<host>.ts.net:4789/ address its `--share` prints.

help.text: The room's web address. Empty uses the room server on this Mac.

rows.note: This Mac's Screen sharing and Control consent switches in Settings > Devices, for a Mac that joined with a pair code or line (contract: cmux machine join, J6-J8). Add Device's join way and the Machines section's joined rows no longer depend on it (cmux#36654, cmux#36667). Off by default. The person turns it on: agents may not (not in SettingsSchema agent-writable keys).

help.text: Shows Screen sharing and Control in Settings > Devices once this Mac joins.

rows.note: Live code (docs/cmux-next/live-code.md): an opt-in, temporary switch. On, a live code build (CMUX_LIVE_CODE_BUILD=1 scripts/reload.sh: CmuxNextApp at -Onone, linked -interposable) watches ~/Library/Caches/cmux-next/live-code and applies Swift patches compiled from the person's checkout (scripts/live-code/patch.py) with no new build. Off, nothing is watched or loaded; Debug and bench builds only until a patch's signer is checked (cmux#13742). Read at launch. The person turns it on: agents may not (it loads code into the app).

help.text: Swift changes you compile apply to the running app. Takes effect after cmux restarts.

rows.note: Bundled Codex app-server (plans/next-ux/ux-harness-health.md, optional bundled Codex app-server): on, a Codex chat whose profile runs plain `codex app-server` starts the app-server in the app-owned bundle folder when its manifest's sha256, version and protocol check out (acpmux codex_bundle.rs), and falls back to the installed CLI otherwise, saying why on the harness health row. A profile naming its own program, CODEX_PATH or a non-stdio --listen keeps its own. Off by default; read at each new chat. The person turns it on: agents may not (it chooses which binary runs).

help.text: New Codex chats use the app server bundled with cmux when it checks out, else your installed Codex.

rows.note: Mac pause/resume experiment (plans/mac-pause-resume/DESIGN.md): new nonpersistent Cloud agent machines opt into the existing 15-minute idle pause and resume when work arrives. Off by default; existing machines and persistent machines are unchanged.

help.text: Pause a new agent machine after 15 idle minutes; it resumes when work arrives.

rows.name: customizeFromTheApp
rows.note: Opt-in Customize surfaces in the window: holding Option over a big part shows the Customize Inspector (its settings, theme colors, Change This… and Reset), and the right-click menus of those parts end with Customize…. Off by default; off hides both, and nothing else changes. Leo 2026-11-15 (ask-9634dbcdac): opt-in UI needs a way back, which is turning this off.

help.text: Hold Option over a part of the window to see what changes it, and right-click it for Customize…. Turn this off to hide both.

rows.name: agentCustomization
rows.note: Opt-in Claude Code and Codex customization (cmux-agent-customize, `cmux agent-config`), each agent's own setup read and changed in the agent's own files: Settings > MCP Servers shows and edits the MCP servers the person gave Claude Code (~/.claude.json, .mcp.json) and Codex (~/.codex/config.toml, .codex/config.toml, plugins); Settings > Agents > Claude Code & Codex lists, edits and turns on or off their skills and slash commands. Off by default; off hides the card and shows only cmux own servers, as before. Leo 2026-11-19: "when I say Claude Code, when I say Codex [...] I need you guys to be, like, doing the thing."

help.text: Show and edit the MCP servers, skills and commands Claude Code and Codex use, in their own config files.

rows.note: Rex-style Hosts section in the sidebar. It projects the Machines page catalog, including Add Host and per-machine terminal actions. Off by default until the sidebar surface is ready.

help.text: Shows your machines in the sidebar with Add Host and per-host terminal actions.
